name: AGC-001 — Spoofed Display-Name Phishing
description: Manual Execution & Real Telemetry (Phase 2) by Ali (TOOSHY2). | AGC-001: Spoofed display-name phishing email delivered credential-harvesting link. Full evidence across Email Headers, OPNsense Firewall, Zeek HTTP, and Wazuh/Sysmon EID 1. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.

techniques.comment: AGC-001: Spearphishing link delivered via spoofed display-name 'IT Support' <it-support@ashford-grove-support.local>. Link opened in browser to 10.10.40.10/portal-login and credentials submitted. Evidenced via Zeek http.log (200 OK), OPNsense live log pass, and Sysmon EID 1 in Wazuh. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.
